text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san, thank you so much for helping 
out with the short video.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No... on the contrary, thank you 
for calling upon me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There was no wind in my head just now... 
so you have saved me. 
Now then, what is it you would like me to 
do...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The theme I want to shoot is... simply 
put, "A Stroll with Maru-Zephyr"! 
We'll introduce friends of Maru-chan and 
Zephyr-san.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's guaranteed to be a huge hit, no doubt 
about it. 
Shall we head over to Poponosuke-san's 
place first?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(It seems... everyone is enjoying it. 
Perhaps that is fine. But I still have 
not—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(I still haven't... raised a wind of my 
own... 
A wind of my very own...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...All right. 
Camera position... set.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Um... *ahem*. 
Imitating the wind... take one. The spring 
breeze... begins.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Flutter, flutter... and then, whoosh, 
whoosh... 
...—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Next, the summer gale... begins. 
...Whoosh, whoosh... swoooosh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—...Zephyr, what in the world are you 
doing?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Nature-san... good afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, totally unphased. 
I'd expect nothing less.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, were you filming a short video or 
something? 
Sorry, sorry! Just let me grab some tea 
real quick!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah... please wait!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Um... what kind of wind did you feel 
reaching you just now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Uhh...? 
...Like a... "Look at me doing 
contemporary dance!" sort of vibe...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah. Sorry, that's definitely not it, 
right? 
What's up? Is there something you're 
trying to convey?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —I see, you want to show your gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... to all the fans. 
To express my heartfelt thanks for always 
being the wind at my back...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That was why I decided to take part 
in this stream in the first place, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, I remember you saying something 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But you know, entertaining everyone... 
wouldn't making short videos like that 
count as saying thanks in its own way?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. However... like everyone else, I 
too... wish to raise a wind of my own.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
How can I give form to these feelings... 
so that they may reach others as something 
distinctly mine?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even if it turns into a gale... I want to 
deliver it to everyone with the pure 
momentum of the wind... 
...I apologize. I am not explaining this 
very well.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's fine. 
I understand what you're trying to say, 
Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I also... kind of want to give 
something back to the people who cheer me 
on, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The folks in the shopping arcade, the 
locals, the people I met during 
out-of-town races...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So many people cheer for me. Look after 
me. 
Even when I tell them it's fine, every 
time they see me they fuss over me... with 
so much warmth.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
They support someone like me without 
expecting anything in return. 
—...Man, that really gives you 
unbelievable power, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—And when I give it my all, everyone's so 
happy. 
Seeing that makes me super happy in 
turn...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Right. That is why I, too...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, then wouldn't that work just fine? 
Yeah, I'm starting to think so!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Why not just pitch your desire to thank 
them directly as a segment idea? 
I don't really know the specific details, 
but... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why you should borrow the 
wisdom of social media masters like 
Curren-san and Maruchan-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep. In times like these, all you 
gotta do is ask! 
Why not give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
............Turn my gratitude... into a 
stream segment...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(The next mini-stream... will be our last 
chance before Valentine's Day. 
I want to build up serious hype and carry 
it all the way to the big day.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wha~t ki~nd of pla~n should we~ go with... 
Hmm. 
Let's see what's trending... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: T-This is...!
